newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was active in the panhandle area late Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed steady to mostly $1.00 higher.

Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 26,800 Slaughter steers and 19,400 heifers; 72,800 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 25,800 formulated and 800 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 65.00 to mostly 66.00. Select, few choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 64.00-65.00.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 65.00 to mostly 66.00. Select, few choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 65.00.
Wk to Date: 72,800 Week Ago: 79,100 Year Ago: 83,200
